mapper.sql:
(select coalesce(sum(d.actualqty), 0) from sdsorder.u_p_receivedetail_${tableSuffix} d where d.shop_code = r.shop_code and d.receivecode = r.receivecode) as total_actual_qty, (select max(d.warehousename) from sdsorder.u_p_receivedetail_${tableSuffix} d where d.shop_code = r.shop_code and d.receivecode = r.receivecode) as warehouse_name,
(select count(1) from sdsorder.u_p_receivedetail_${tableSuffix} d where d.shop_code = r.shop_code and d.receivecode = r.receivecode and d.actualqty is not null) as processing_lines

id, shop_code, receivecode, purchasecode, senddate, logisticsno, carrier, freighttype, estfreightamount, freightamount, totalqty, receivetime, receiveuser, status, remark, createuser, createtime, updateuser, updatetime

r.id, r.shop_code, r.receivecode, r.purchasecode, r.senddate, r.logisticsno, r.carrier, r.freighttype, r.estfreightamount, r.freightamount, r.totalqty, r.receivetime, r.receiveuser, r.status, r.remark, r.createuser, r.createtime, r.updateuser, r.updatetime
left join sys_user ru on ru.user_name = r.receiveuser left join sys_user cu on cu.user_name = r.createuser
mapper.select:
select , ru.nick_name as receive_user_name, cu.nick_name as create_user_name,
from sdsorder.u_p_receive_${tableSuffix} r
where r.shop_code = #{query.shopCode} and r.status = '待入库' and not exists (select 1 from sdsorder.u_p_receivedetail_${tableSuffix} d where d.shop_code = r.shop_code and d.receivecode = r.receivecode and d.actualqty is not null) order by r.senddate desc, r.createtime desc
mapper.insert: insert into sdsorder.u_p_receive_${tableSuffix} (shop_code, receivecode, purchasecode, senddate, logisticsno, carrier, freighttype, estfreightamount, freightamount, totalqty, receivetime, receiveuser, status, remark, createuser, createtime) values (#{receive.shopCode}, #{receive.receiveCode}, #{receive.purchaseCode}, #{receive.sendDate}, #{receive.logisticsNo}, #{receive.carrier}, #{receive.freightType}, coalesce(#{receive.estFreightAmount}, 0), coalesce(#{receive.freightAmount}, 0), #{receive.totalQty}, null, null, #{receive.status}, #{receive.remark}, #{receive.createUser}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update sdsorder.u_p_receive_${tableSuffix} set senddate = #{receive.sendDate}, logisticsno = #{receive.logisticsNo}, carrier = #{receive.carrier}, freighttype = #{receive.freightType}, estfreightamount = #{receive.estFreightAmount}, totalqty = #{receive.totalQty}, remark = #{receive.remark}, updateuser = #{receive.updateUser}, updatetime = sysdate() where shop_code = #{receive.shopCode} and receivecode = #{receive.receiveCode} and status = '待入库'

update sdsorder.u_p_receive_${tableSuffix} set receiveuser = coalesce(#{receiveUser}, receiveuser), receivetime = coalesce(#{receiveTime}, receivetime), freightamount = greatest(coalesce(freightamount, 0) + coalesce(#{freightDelta}, 0), 0), updateuser = #{username}, updatetime = sysdate() where shop_code = #{shopCode} and receivecode = #{receiveCode}
mapper.delete: delete from sdsorder.u_p_receive_${tableSuffix} where shop_code = #{shopCode} and receivecode = #{receiveCode} and status = '待入库'
